dataList.content:
认得……
 Know...

<他刚才说话了？！>
 <Did they just speak?!>

嚯？！布布小家伙，汝原来一直都会说话？
 Hoh?! Young Pwie, thou possessed the gift of speech all along?

……我认得……你们两个……
 ... I know... you two...

布布的目光警惕地在默尔索和我之间游移。
 Pwie's gaze wavered warily between Meursault and me.

我哭了……好多……因为好痛……也因为好难过……我起不来……
 I cried... a lot... 'Cuz it hurt a lot... and 'cuz I was sad... And I couldn't get up...

因为你们两个……我好害怕……而且越来越怕，越来越怕……
  'Cuz of you two... I was scared... And it only got scarier and scarier...

<……布布记得清仓之前发生的事。>
 <... Pwie remembers what happened before the Liquidation.>

对不起。
 I am sorry.

……为什么？
 ... Why?

因为我们的行为让你受了苦。
 Because our actions have led to your suffering.

<默尔索……>
 <Meursault...>

……可是我现在不哭了。
 ... But I stopped crying now.

……所以……我也不知道眼泪是什么意思了。
 ... So... I dunno what tears mean anymore.

我想忘掉……可是……不可以……
 I wanna forget... but... I shouldn't...

总觉得……他很困惑呢。
 Somehow... they seem very confused.

布布盯着地面嘟囔了一阵，然后试探着朝我们迈了一步。
 Pwie muttered for a bit while staring at the ground, then took a tentative step toward us.

你们为什么……来找我？
 Why'd you... come to me?

因为你呼唤了我们。
 Because you called to us.

我……为什么要呼唤？
 Why... did I?

这个……我们目前还答不上来。或许是有什么把我们引向了你。
 That's... not a question we have an answer to at the moment. Perhaps something drew us toward you.

……我得上到五层去。
 ... I gotta go up to fifth floor.

我睡着的时候……那里还有别人和我在一起……
 When I was sleeping... there were others there with me...

他们说……他们悄悄说……等我醒来，大家都会很高兴见到我，会欢迎我。他们还唱了一首很好听的歌……
 They said... They whispered that... everyone's gonna be so happy to see me and welcome me when I wake up. They even sang a really nice song... too.

是你们唱给我听的吗？
 Did you sing to me?

不。唱歌的不是我们。为你唱歌的，是你醒来不久后亲手碰过的那个女人。
 No. We did not sing to you. The one who sang to you is the woman whom you laid your hands on shortly after your awakening.

可是……她不动。也不跟我说话。
 But... she didn't move. Or speak to me.

那是因为……她死了。
 That's because... she is dead.

死了……就不能动了吗？
 You can't move... when you're dead?

不能。
 No.

为什么……？
 Why...?

因为身体已停止运作，意识也已熄灭。
 Because the body has ceased to function, and the mind has been extinguished.

熄灭……？意识……？好奇怪的词。
 Extinguish...? Mind...? Weird words.

我不喜欢。
 I don't like that.

<唔……是啊，这些概念本来就不好懂。尤其是在西西弗百货里面。>
 <Hmmm... Yeah, they're not the most straightforward of concepts. Especially inside the Grand Magasin.>

我躺在地上……眼睛闭着……
 I was lying on the ground... and my eyes were closed...

我觉得……那就是死。可是我又醒过来了。没有熄灭。
 I think... that was death. But I woke up again. Didn't get extinguished.

……因为在西西弗百货里死去，与在外面死去，是根本不同的概念。
 ... Because dying within the Grand Magasin is a fundamentally different concept from dying outside of it.

……为什么不一样……？
 ... Why is it different...?

因为……
 Because...

……我不知道。我不知道是否真的存在差别。
 ... I don't know. I don't know if there really is any difference.

……我……不喜欢。
 ... I don't... like that.

我不想……被熄灭。
 I don't want to... get extinguished.

……还有我……
 ... And I...

我饿了。
 I'm hungry.

所以我想吃东西，可是……有人从我手里抢走了。
 So I tried to eat something, but... someone took it from me.

呸，没想到世上还有别的灵魂，做着年轻的希斯克利夫先生那般的行径！
 Fie, to think that there were other souls with young Heathcliff's antics!

<形容得莫名具体，但……也挺准。>
 <Oddly specific, but... also spot-on.>

这一层好像没有餐厅呢，不过……如果这儿真是“百货商店”，那总该有卖吃的地方吧。
 I don't see any restaurants on this floor, but... if this really is a "department store," there has to be places selling food somewhere.

我们一起去找找看，好吗？
 Let's go find one together, hmm?

……嗯。
 ... Okay.

布布似乎仍和我们隔着些距离，但我注意到，祂不像先前那样远远落在后面了。祂站在离我们不远处，眼神发着直……
 Though Pwie seemed to be giving us a somewhat wide berth still, I noticed that they weren't hanging as far back as they were before. They were standing some distance from us with a blank stare in their eyes...

……像是在等我们去往某处。
 ... as though they were waiting for us to go somewhere.
